parameters.content: ## DISPOSITION ENDPOINT\n`POST /webhook/pipedrive/disposition`\nNormalize -> 11 parallel IF gates -> Merge -> Respond. Each gate fires only if its key is present.

## DISCOVERY (run this to get IDs)

Click **Execute** on **Discover: IDs Summary** (or run the trigger).

Output table:
- `kind = STAGE` -> `id` = **stage_id** (note `pipeline_id`)
- `kind = OWNER` -> `id` = **owner_id** (name + email)
- `kind = LABEL` -> `id` = **add_label_id / remove_label_id** (your tags)

Global host, works before COMPANY_DOMAIN is set. Delete this sub-flow once IDs are copied.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ title: $json.title, status: 'open', pipeline_id: $json.pipeline_id, stage_id: $json.stage_id, person_id: Number($json.person_id) }, $json.owner_id != null ? { owner_id: $json.owner_id } : {})) }}

parameters.content:
## STAGE + OWNER BY NAME

Send from GHL customData:
- **deal_id**, **person_id** (from search)
- **stage_name** = the disposition, e.g. `Qualified - Didn't Book`, `Busy`, `Qualified - Booked`
- **owner_name** (e.g. `Jay Rechtshaffen`) or **owner_email** (more reliable)

Stage branch: GET deal -> read its pipeline -> map name to the right stage.
- Online Leads (9): name -> its own stage
- Term Loans (2): Qual-Booked->98; {Qual-Didn't-Book, Not Interested, Busy}->97; else no change

Owner is resolved in Normalize (id > email > name) and assigned via the existing owner branch.
